payload.name: ExtractEventFromRelativeTimeMention
payload.description: When a user mentions attending an event, meetup, or activity with a relative time phrase (e.g., last week, recently), extract an event memory during extraction.
content: During extraction, when a user states they attended an event, meetup, gathering, or activity with a relative time reference (e.g., 'last week', 'yesterday', 'recently'), create a candidate event memory.
Resolve the relative time from the message/session timestamp to a concrete date or date range.

If the user describes the event's purpose or theme (e.g., 'to support each other'), include it briefly in the description; do not invent a specific event name beyond what is stated. Do not apply to future plans, hypothetical events, or explicit non-attendance.

solves: Extraction fails when a user mentions an attended event using relative time and informal wording, producing no memory. This Skill applies to any message where the user references having gone to an event, meetup, or activity in a relative past timeframe, and instructs extracting an event memory with resolved date. It must not apply to future plans, hypothetical events, or messages with no event reference.
